hard_blockers: iroh-roq 0.1.0 pins iroh ^0.33; iroh-dag-sync pins iroh 1.0.0-rc.1; sendme 0.37.1 is binary-only
quic-rpc iroh-transport pulls iroh ^0.35; irpc ^0.17 vs ^1.0 skew

invariants.idempotence: f(f(x)) == f(x), witnessed by scheduler-fixed-point and crdt-join-laws
invariants.disjoint_surfaces: one writer per module; PartitionKey(account,region) indexes every replicated map
invariants.crdt: Lww with symmetric digest tie-break, OrSet with observed-remove, GCounter, VersionVector
invariants.persistence: checksummed journal frames plus snapshot, recovery across restart
invariants.authz: HMAC-SHA256 capabilities with constant-time verify, Scope derived from validated account
invariants.effects: pure transitions return Vec<Effect>; only net::execute performs IO
invariants.bounds: 1 MiB frame cap, 1 MiB payload cap, 8192-byte HTTP read, p99 chaos witness

hardware_bound: full 440-crate workspace requires about 100 GiB target; per-crate builds and a nested fabric workspace are used instead
